Replay removes only selected contribution effects: original details fields, contents values and dominance edges, removal tokens or Restore effects. Concurrent or later independent work remains. Undo Add suppresses untouched seeds from active and Deleted without inventing removal tokens; surviving direct history protects only its own physical targets.
No new database/schema, task v3, transport, import, permanent recovery file or profile ownership change is introduced by these three core files.

Undo retry after canonical acknowledgement returns empty rather than appending duplicate inverse; failed before-bytes, complete-prefix and acknowledgement failures retain exact protected receipts for recovery and restart.
